meta.name: fluidsim
meta.description: Plan, configure, inspect, restart, and analyze bounded FluidSim computational-fluid-dynamics simulations with explicit numerical-validity and HPC safety checks. Use for FluidSim solver selection, parameter review, FFT/MPI setup, output diagnostics, or restart compatibility.

copy.tagline: 规划配置计算流体动力学仿真，进行数值有效性与HPC安全检查
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你在做流体动力学仿真，需要确保计算参数有效
copy.tagline_en: Plan, configure, and analyze FluidSim CFD simulations with validity and HPC safety checks
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you conduct fluid dynamics simulations and need to ensure numerical validity and HPC safety

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能帮你用 FluidSim 做流体模拟：选求解器、配参数、设 FFT/MPI，检查数值合理性，分析结果，判断能否重启。
howto.when: 当你提到要运行流体模拟（如 Navier-Stokes 方程、浅水方程），或涉及湍流、涡旋等场景，或要求做求解器选择、参数检查、输出分析时触发。

say.text: 帮我配置一个 2D 湍流模拟，256 网格，粘度 1e-3
say.note: Claude 会生成配置脚本并检查参数合理性

say.text: 我想用浅水方程模拟旋转流体，怎么设置科里奥利参数？
say.note: Claude 会给出参数建议和代码示例

say.text: 这个模拟输出怎么分析？帮我画涡量图
say.note: Claude 会调用输出分析功能呈现结果

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can help you use FluidSim for fluid simulations: selecting solvers, configuring parameters, setting up FFT/MPI, checking numerical validity, analyzing results, and judging restart compatibility.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention running fluid dynamics simulations (e.g., Navier-Stokes, shallow water), or analyzing turbulence, vortices, geophysical flows, or when requesting solver selection, parameter review, output analysis.

say_en.text: Configure a 2D turbulence simulation at 256 grid with viscosity 1e-3.
say_en.note: Claude will generate a config script and check parameter validity.

say_en.text: How do I set the Coriolis parameter for a shallow-water rotating flow?
say_en.note: Claude will suggest parameter values and show code.

say_en.text: How do I analyze outputs? Plot the vorticity field.
say_en.note: Claude will use output analysis to present results.
